verdict.rationale: RudderStack's warehouse-first design keeps event data in the customer's own infrastructure under a documented, predefined warehouse schema (docs-65, docs-30). Profiles are defined in version-controlled YAML that generates warehouse-native SQL (docs-35), and a self-hostable open-source version runs on PostgreSQL (docs-58). Together these reduce lock-in, and a community user cites 'total control of our data' after migrating off Segment. However, there is no documented export or offboarding feature, and no open file formats (e.g., CSV/Parquet/JSON) are named. missing for 10: explicit bulk data export feature, named open export formats, export of workspace configuration (sources/destinations/transformations), documented exit/migration-away path, hands-on corroboration of leaving.
